methods.description: Read product as multiplication. Write the multiplication for given factors, or distinguish its factors from the result. A given equality can identify the product without recalculating it.
Calculate a whole-number product by multiplying two factors at a time, keeping every factor. The same calculation method applies to two, three or four factors; factor count is not a separate method.

Use the same factors in a different order or group a useful pair first. Neither change alters the product. Calculate using a helpful pair, or explain that reordered identical factors have equal products without recalculating both. Elementary adaptation of the actual Stage3 product/array and filled grouping contexts; later booklet arrays support style only.
